venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 2/12.** Very busy right off the jump: packed room at 7 incl. a 16-top across the party pod and the 20s; fully sat by 9; only one guest waitlisted thanks to quick turns. Settled by 10:30, smooth into last call save one 4-top just before the bell; cleared by 1am. Kitchen: nearly 12% of sales; a few multi-course tables. MOD: Jamal / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 2/12.** Slower start becoming a busier evening of medium and larger parties; guests relaxed without long waitlists; served some home bartenders comparing how drinks are made. Comps $123.14 (2.5%) because food was coming out slowly. Door: friends gathering with 3s and 4s; 8pm boost, busiest ~10pm, held ~2/3 capacity, slowed ~11:30; creative seating for 3s; trend of guests coming in after Alan Cumming's club night (Traitors premiere). No no-shows. Repairs: ceiling leak in the office.
